BL-1399 — The freshness watchdog property fixture supplies its own required-daemon registry through the guard's existing seam, so its deliberately one-row conf is not refused by the fail-closed registry guard - the standing red bl1012 on main
What it solves: `required_wiring` anchor 1 is a consumer anchor in the BL-1235 sense: the
literal is the guard's own env name, absent from the test today; it can
only appear if the fixture uses the seam.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. The red is a fixture reading production's required-daemon list while writing a one-row conf on purpose; the guard has had a seam for exactly this since it was written.
BL-1399 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1399" (or "reject BL-1399 <reason>") to act.
